transaction_manifest.title: Native Harness integrated-runner first controlled development closeout

node.title: Native Harness integrated-runner first controlled development closeout

notes: Yuri's standing uninterrupted-development authority covered one exact authored-synthetic useful-work attempt.
The one occupied identity is consumed and no retry, resume, fallback or replacement is authorized.
The successor is provider-free and cannot launch a Harness model turn, broker or provider request.

decisions.summary: Accept one consumed failed-closed native-Harness terminal at the integrated runner factory stage after both readiness coordinates and before any model or provider request.
Reject any useful-development or DeepSeek-performance claim because no request, tool call, edit or candidate occurred.
Reject any further occupied attempt until a separately bounded provider-free factory-subcoordinate diagnosis resolves or terminally characterizes the pre-request failure.

claim_scope: Exactly one rc.7 native-Harness process crossed sentinel_activated and stock_headless_hmr_ready.
The accepted integrated runner then failed closed at its factory stage before agent publication.
Model requests, provider calls, tool calls, tool results, changed paths and candidate tests all remained zero.
The consumed attempt used zero retry, resume, fallback, auxiliary model or second worker.
Harness, broker and disposable root are absent and raw runtime material was not retained.
The result improves failure localization but proves neither useful DeepSeek output nor general Harness reliability.
No product, ordinary-practice, data, production, deployment, release, Pages or protected-ref authority opened.
unresolved_gates: The runner factory failure is not yet split into a closed agent-creation or setup subcoordinate.
No model request, DeepSeek reasoning result, useful edit or candidate exists.
No further occupied native-Harness attempt is authorized before provider-free factory diagnosis.
Ordinary practice, product data, production, deployment, release, Pages and protected integration remain closed.

journey.strategic_role: Test whether orchestrator-controlled native-Harness gear can produce one useful traceable DeepSeek development contribution
journey.outcome: The one-shot attempt crossed HMR readiness but failed at the integrated runner factory stage before any provider request or candidate.

current_position.strategic_role: Resolve the exact pre-request factory substage without spending another provider attempt
current_position.why_now: The occupied result proves loading and readiness but localizes the remaining blocker only to factory; another occupied launch would repeat cost without removing the known uncertainty.
current_position.outcome: Startup, HMR, runner loading and provider-zero boundaries are exact; agent creation or setup remains the sole current blocker.
unlocks: A finite provider-free factory substage coordinate.
A correction design that can be tested without a model request.
An evidence-based stop or go decision for any later useful-worker attempt.
does_not_solve: No useful DeepSeek worker result or general native-Harness reliability conclusion.
No authority for another occupied request.
No ordinary-practice, product-data, production or protected-ref authority.
current_position.orientation_statement: EMR4 will diagnose the integrated runner factory boundary provider-free and will not spend another occupied DeepSeek attempt on the unresolved coordinate.

next_operation.active_tranche: DeepSeek native Harness provider-free integrated-runner factory-subcoordinate diagnostic recovery
next_operation.objective: Exercise the exact installed integrated-runner agents.create and setup boundary with closed provider-free fixtures, derive a sanitized finite factory-substage coordinate, and freeze the narrowest correction or stop decision without a Harness model turn, broker or provider request.
next_operation.authority_source: Yuri's standing uninterrupted-development authority and the accepted traceable factory-stage terminal.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Git identities in Ariadne git_refs_and_worktree evidence must come only from the machine snapshot.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first preplanning runtime state repeated two exact Git object IDs in prose and the preflight rejected it with git_refs_evidence_manual_object_id_forbidden.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The Ariadne preflight returned revision_required before any worker, model or provider authority was opened.

correction.action: Remove manual object identities from the evidence prose and regenerate from the machine snapshot.
correction.prevention_control: Treat git_refs_and_worktree narrative as an identity-free description and leave every exact ref to the generated snapshot.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected manual Git-identity repetition and preserves machine-only Git ref authority.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Runner source assertions must distinguish a function definition from its invocation.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first focused test expected the preflightEditArguments text once although the accepted source correctly contains one definition and one call.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Focused pytest failed before contract publication or occupied preparation.

correction.action: Assert the exact exported definition and exact call-site fragment separately.
correction.prevention_control: Use role-specific source anchors instead of counting a shared function-name substring.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the corrected source-count assertion that now separates definition and invocation roles.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The controller must import its repository modules both as a test module and when executed directly by path.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first direct --write-contract invocation could not import the scripts package because repository-root bootstrapping was omitted.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Direct controller execution failed before writing a contract or starting any runtime process.

correction.action: Insert the repository root into sys.path before repository-package imports.
correction.prevention_control: Exercise each new controller both through pytest import and one direct CLI invocation before contract freeze.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the direct-script import bootstrap correction and dual import/CLI execution control.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every closed nested JSON object must declare the properties it admits.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first contract generation found nested objects with additionalProperties false but no properties maps, so every intended member was rejected.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Draft 2020-12 validation failed before a contract file, preparation or occupied lease existed.

correction.action: Declare every admitted nested property and regenerate the exact contract from final schema bytes.
correction.prevention_control: Validate a representative complete instance against every new closed schema before contract publication.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the closed nested-schema property correction and complete-instance validation control.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: PowerShell chunk boundaries must evaluate scalar arithmetic before array construction.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first fresh AGENTS read constructed the final chunk with an unparenthesized array subtraction expression and PowerShell rejected it.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The read-only command failed before dispatch; the complete read was immediately rerun with typed chunk objects.

correction.action: Parenthesize the scalar subtraction and represent chunk bounds as named objects.
correction.prevention_control: Use explicit Start/End objects for future chunked PowerShell reads.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the corrected PowerShell chunk-bound expression used for complete rehydration.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Checkpoint readback through nested adapters must activate both the outer identity binding and the accepted controller binding.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first read-only checkpoint probe activated only the outer adapter and therefore printed the historical base checkpoint instead of the current one.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The unexpected candidate and runner hashes visibly disagreed with the frozen checkpoint and were rejected before any launch.

correction.action: Activate the accepted attempt's nested controller context before reading the current checkpoint and compare the exact frozen identities.
correction.prevention_control: Expose a future adapter-owned prepared-check entry point rather than probing nested controller internals directly.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected historical checkpoint readback and requires both nested adapter contexts.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: After exact readiness and runner loading, the bounded agent factory must publish one session and permit one provider request for the frozen synthetic task.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The integrated runner failed closed at factory after readiness, with zero model request, provider call, tool activity or candidate.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The runner's sanitized terminal reported failure_stage factory; the outer terminal, broker counters and unchanged synthetic hash corroborated it.

correction.action: Consume the attempt, preserve the typed terminal, decline retry and move to a provider-free factory-subcoordinate diagnostic.
correction.prevention_control: Require a closed provider-free agents.create/setup fixture to pass before any later occupied request can be considered.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the consumed factory-stage Harness failure and bars another occupied attempt before provider-free diagnosis.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A closeout with new error observations must bind exactly the prospective register revision document in its acceptance paths.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first closeout dry-run carried eight observations but omitted the prospective Revision 621 document path and failed closed with tick_incident_revision_path.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The governance clockwork rejected the intent before generation construction or canonical publication.

correction.action: Add the exact prospective Revision 621 path to the node artifacts and baton acceptance before rerunning the idempotent dry check.
correction.prevention_control: When agent_error_observations is nonempty, derive the prospective revision path from the current register revision plus one before assembling acceptance paths.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected missing prospective register path and requires revision-path derivation before closeout validation.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The prospective register revision note must contain one ordered level-two heading for every newly projected incident ID.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The second closeout dry-run found the correct machine reading but only a bullet list, so the exact projected AER heading list was absent and it failed closed with tick_incident_revision_reading.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The governance clockwork rejected the document before generation construction or canonical publication.

correction.action: Render one ordered level-two AER heading for every projected ID and update the embedded complete register reading.
correction.prevention_control: Generate revision headings from the same projected incident-ID sequence used for the machine comment.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected bullet-only revision note and requires ordered headings from projected incident IDs.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The active Baton acceptance lookup must remain inside the deterministic live-handover byte and line budget.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The third closeout dry-run tried to place the full detailed artifact inventory in the active Baton row and failed closed with tick_baton_compaction_budget.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The governance clockwork rejected prospective Baton rendering before generation construction or canonical publication.

correction.action: Keep the detailed artifact inventory in the immutable closeout graph and reduce the active Baton row to the essential lookup paths.
correction.prevention_control: Measure the prospective Baton rendering budget before assembling an exhaustive active acceptance list.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected exhaustive Baton inventory and keeps detailed artifacts in the closeout graph behind a compact active lookup.
